_readme: Physical-trading economics. Every value has a realistic 2020-2026 range and a _source. Ranges are approximate public-reporting levels, not quotes; edit freely. Scenario files may override a value (e.g. a scenario's own charter rate).

default_bbl._source: A typical Aframax crude parcel is ~500-750 kbbl (80-120 kt); 500 kbbl is a standard US Gulf export lot.

charter_usd_day._source: Aframax time-charter-equivalent earnings ran roughly $15k-$40k/day in quiet markets 2020-21 and $50k-$100k+/day in 2022-23 after Russia-related rerouting (Baltic Exchange TD9/TD25, Clarksons market reports).

demurrage_usd_day._source: Charter-party demurrage is usually set near the prevailing charter rate for the vessel size (ASBATANKVOY practice); Aframax demurrage commonly $25k-$60k/day 2020-2025.

laytime_days._source: Standard laytime of 36 running hours for discharge (ASBATANKVOY / BPVOY4 forms).

port_costs_usd._source: Port dues, pilotage, towage, agency and terminal charges for an Aframax call in the US Gulf or NW Europe, approx. $60k-$250k per call.

financing_pct_year._source: Trade finance ~SOFR + 1-2%: SOFR was near 0.05% in 2021 and ~5.3% in 2023-24 (NY Fed).

quality_penalty_usd_bbl._source: Off-spec settlements (sulfur, cloud point, cetane, water) are typically negotiated at $0.10-$1.00/bbl discounts (industry practice; Argus/Platts quality differentials).

capacity_bbl._source: A single large Cushing/Houston tank lease is 300-600 kbbl; 500 kbbl keeps the arithmetic simple.

rent_cushing_usd_bbl_month._source: Cushing term leases typically $0.25-$0.50/bbl/month; spot storage was reported at roughly $0.85-$1.00+ in April 2020 (Reuters, Bloomberg).

rent_houston_usd_bbl_month._source: US Gulf Coast storage leases typically ~$0.40-$0.60/bbl/month; higher in tight periods (industry reports).

margin_of_safety_usd_bbl_month._source: Desks typically require a buffer over rent + financing before committing to a carry trade (operational risk, roll slippage).

cushing_working_capacity_mmbbl._source: EIA 'Working and Net Available Shell Storage Capacity' report: Cushing working storage capacity ~76-78 million bbl in 2019-2021 (~73 in 2015-16).

credit_line_usd._source: A mid-size trading desk's hedge margin facility. CME WTI (CL) initial margin ran roughly $5k-$10k per contract over 2020-2025, so ~250 hedge lots need ~$1.5-2.5M of margin capacity.

lot_bbl._source: NYMEX CL / ICE Brent / NYMEX HO/RB contract size is 1,000 bbl (42,000 gal).

round_days._source: Each counter or stall burns about half a day of the voyage clock (game rule).

counter_step_usd_bbl._source: Crude differentials are quoted to the nickel ($0.05/bbl) in physical trade (Argus/Platts assessment convention).

distress_shading_usd_bbl_day._source: Buyers widen bids once a seller is visibly on demurrage; $0.02-$0.15/bbl per day is the order of daily demurrage cost per barrel on an Aframax ($45k/day ÷ 500 kbbl ≈ $0.09/bbl).

relationship_adjust_usd_bbl._source: Counterparty relationship effects on opening bids (game rule, sized well inside typical bid/ask of $0.10-$0.25).

avg5_window_days._source: Common pricing term: average of quotes over five days around the bill of lading or discharge date.

seller_clock_ratio._source: Spot discounts for prompt Cushing barrels widened as stocks passed ~75-80% of working capacity in April 2020 and early 2016 (EIA WPSR; Reuters/Argus market reports). Above this ratio a seller's 'their clock' shows.
